# degree count

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:degreeCount`](gmeow-degreeCount.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/degreeCount>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
